> if you want less images to load, you can use `configure({ hitsPerPage: 5 })` to show only five hits, is that what you want?
> 
> Otherwise if you're looking for lazy-loading, InstantSearch isn't opinionated around that, there's many solutions that exist for it that, even one builtin to the browser now (loading=lazy on the image) https://web.dev/browser-level-image-lazy-loading/

I don’t understand in which file you need to register this?
`loading=lazy` doesn't work in my case because the plugin does not substitute lazy value for js content.

The ideal solution would be to defer the load of InstantSearch  **until the moment the user clicks on the search**.
